root_cause: Protel did not drop the link. A passive headers-only capture on the appliance (port 5003, snaplen 66, no payload) showed the APPLIANCE sending the first FIN in every session end, preceded by our own 5-byte LE and no RST anywhere. 23 of 24 session ends since 2026-10-23 coincide to the millisecond with Postgres 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint se_live_identity' (the 24th was a deploy restart): Protel re-sent a byte-identical live record, the plain INSERT failed, pmsd treated the untyped error as fatal, reconnected, requested a full resync, and Protel re-sent again — the storms of 2026-10-24 10:40 and 12:37-12:46. Each resync then closed Room sign-in because the connected branch required IN_SYNC.

Since the deploy no duplicate-key error and no unclassified session end.
